import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,re
a=json.load(open("inputs/accepted57-scopes.json")); p=json.load(open("inputs/prior39-scopes.json"))
print({k:(type(v).__name__,len(v) if hasattr(v,'__len__') else v) for k,v in a.items()})
print({k:(type(v).__name__,len(v) if hasattr(v,'__len__') else v) for k,v in p.items()})
la=max((v for v in a.values() if isinstance(v,list)),key=len); lp=max((v for v in p.values() if isinstance(v,list)),key=len)
print(len(la),len(lp),sorted(la[0].keys()),sorted(lp[0].keys()))
pat=re.compile(r"bunkbed|tournament|percolat|reachab|bond |two-layer|digraph|directed graph|DAG|acyclic",re.I)
def show(rows,name):
    print("==",name,len(rows))
    n=0
    for r in rows:
        t=json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)
        m=sorted(set(x.lower() for x in pat.findall(t)))
        if m:
            n+=1
            print(r.get("mathdb_id"),"|",r.get("title"),"|",m)
            print("   ",(r.get("statement") or r.get("source_target") or r.get("scope") or "")[:420].replace("\n"," "))
    print("hits",n)
show(la,"accepted57");show(lp,"prior39")
